x: Andre Johnson was a convincing winner of the short sprint as was fellow Junior Mat George in the high hurdles, and it was nice to welcome a new face to the 400 metre scene - Phil Turner.

Two-lap man Dave Pamah, inspired by Kiptanui's front running in Grand Prix races had decided that he too needed no pacemakers and blasted a first lap that saw him well clear of the field and beyond being caught, and when an unexpected victory came from Phil Turner in the 400 metres the Bels. began to feel unbeatable.
